   MOTION TO WITHDRAW AS COUNSEL FOR INTERVENOR, DONNA BAKER

        COMES NOW, Sheldon E. Richie, Ryan W. Wood, and the firm Richie & Gueringer, P.C.

(collectively, “Counsel”), counsel of record for Intervenor, Donna Baker (Party 545), and files this

their Motion to Withdraw as Counsel for Intervenor, Donna Baker, and in support thereof

respectfully shows:

        1.      Good cause exist for Counsel’s withdraw as Intervenor, Donna Baker has requested

that Counsel end their engagement with and withdraw as counsel of record for Intervenor, Donna

Baker, in this matter. Intervenor, Donna Baker consents to this Motion.

                              STATUS OF DEADLINES/SETTINGS

        2.      The Hearing on the Merits has already taken place in this matter on June 5, 2026 to

June 12, 2026. Following are the only deadlines in this matter pursuant to SOAH Order No. 35

(Dkt. No. 6597), which Intervenor, Donna Baker has been notified of:

              a.    Briefs on Preliminary Order Issue 11 and 13 are due by October 7, 2026; and

              b.    Responses on the Briefs on Preliminary Order Issue 11 and 13 are due by
                    October 19, 2026.

                                               PRAYER
